AttendanceRecord.title: Attendance record
AttendanceRecord.description: One clock day per employee (klokregistratie): raw clockIn/clockOut timestamps, a break duration, and the working day they belong to. Feeds the three Arbeidstijdenwet checks (nl-arbeidstijdenwet, lib/Standards/rules/labour.json) via NlAttendanceChecks and the RuleAuditService attendance context. AttendanceRecord is raw clock data; Timesheet (hr-timesheet.json) remains the per-period approved-hours record — aggregating attendance into a timesheet is a documented follow-up (time-attendance-mvp design D5), not automated here. No approval states on this schema; the open<->gesloten lifecycle only tracks whether the day is still being clocked or is complete.

sluiten.description: The employee closes the day once clocked out. The carrying write supplies clockOut and workedHours (writer-maintained, not a declarative calculation — see workedHours description).

heropenen.description: Reopen a closed day for correction. Edits stay visible in the audit trail (the SickLeaveCase heropenen precedent).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the employee this clock day belongs to.

date.title: Date
date.description: The working day this record belongs to (ISO 8601 date), including for a night shift whose clockOut falls after midnight — the working-day key stays this record's date.

clockIn.title: Clock in
clockIn.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee started work (the fleet's submittedAt timestamp convention).

clockOut.title: Clock out
clockOut.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee stopped work; null while the day is still open. The nl-atw-max-werkdag and nl-atw-pauze checks pass vacuously while this is null (shift length not decidable yet).

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: Total unpaid break minutes taken during the shift. Input to the nl-atw-pauze check (Arbeidstijdenwet art. 5:4 lid 1 break tiers).

workedHours.title: Worked hours
workedHours.description: Stored, writer-maintained number: (clockOut minus clockIn) in hours, minus breakMinutes/60, rounded to 2 decimals. NOT a declarative x-openregister-calculations field — that operator vocabulary is prop/+/- over numeric properties only and cannot express a date-time subtraction. Presentation/aggregation convenience only: the Arbeidstijdenwet compliance checks always compute from the raw clockIn/clockOut/breakMinutes fields, never from this value, so a stale or hand-edited workedHours can neither mask nor fabricate a violation.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the day was worked. Plain metadata — no GPS/geofence tracking (deferred, own AVG/consent spec).

userId.title: User
userId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this record belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service pattern) — a plain NC-user-id string, a copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, never a $ref relation, mirroring the Timesheet.userId description verbatim. Drives the MijnAanwezigheid @me self-service page.

status.title: Status
status.description: Clock-day lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (open <-> gesloten). No approval states here — approval of worked hours lives on Timesheet.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this AttendanceRecord is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.
